rules.official_behavior: getTinChkCode concatenates the three 3-character TIN segments, treats all-blank as valid, explicitly accepts 999999999 as a testing bypass, and otherwise delegates to the external chkt.exe through VBScript ValidateTinWChkDgt.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Never carry the 999999999 test bypass into production. Use a reviewed native checksum implementation and preserve compatibility observations separately.

gaps: chkt.exe was not present in the inspected runtime extraction or C:\eBIRForms tree, so its algorithm and return codes remain unverified.
Primary 1701Q Validate does not invoke getTinChkCode; spouse validation does.
